service_boundary.transport: bounded unary protobuf; GetTM NEXT is a cancellable bounded long poll

source_rules: The bundled deterministic simulator reports SIMULATOR or SIMULATOR_GCS_TIME with deterministic simulator provenance.
SIMULATOR_GCS_TIME is explicitly simulator-emulated and never claims live GCS, mission-network, or legacy-adapter evidence.
A host-clock fallback reports HOST_FALLBACK and never reports or implies GCS or SIMULATOR_GCS_TIME.
Live GCS, mission-network, and legacy-adapter clock routes are rejected and outside this gate.
Uncertainty is a nonnegative integer and is never omitted or inferred as zero.
time_rules: All wire times are signed Unix nanoseconds with an explicit UTC interpretation.
The driver supplies acquisition time; the backend supplies receive time.
Clock regression, overflow, unavailable provenance, and excessive uncertainty are typed outcomes rather than substituted values.

scalar_value.wire_shape: oneof with one explicit type tag and one value

json_rules.FINITE_DOUBLE: JSON number with NaN and infinity forbidden

item_identity.identity_rule: ItemId and CatalogDigest identify one immutable bounded catalog definition; display names never substitute for ItemId.
item_identity.catalog_rule: The simulator catalog is finite, versioned, deterministic, and digest-bound. Unknown items return NOT_FOUND without mutation.

sample_identity.canonical_identity: SampleId is the digest of SourceId, SourceEpoch, ItemId, and SourceSequence.
sample_identity.sequence_scope: strictly increasing per SourceId, SourceEpoch, and ItemId
sample_identity.restart_rule: A source restart creates a new SourceEpoch; sequences in different epochs are never numerically compared.
sample_identity.duplicate_rule: The same identity and payload digest is idempotent; the same identity with different content is a contract violation.
sample_identity.gap_rule: A jump beyond the next expected source sequence is preserved as an explicit gap and never synthesized away.

telemetry_sample.orthogonality_rule: Validity, quality, freshness, stream synchronization, and availability are independent facts and are never collapsed into one status.
telemetry_sample.atomicity_rule: Raw value, engineering value, identity, time, source, validity, quality, and metadata come from one locked simulator sample and one source sequence.
telemetry_sample.receive_time_rule: ReceivedAt is assigned by the backend authoritative clock at durable ingestion and cannot be supplied by the driver or browser.
telemetry_sample.freshness_rule: Server policy evaluates freshness from the pinned policy revision, receive time, acquisition time when comparable, and clock uncertainty; browser age is presentation only.

get_tm_modes.sequence_rule: does not promise a sample newer than a caller cursor

get_tm_modes.input: complete context-generation tuple, ItemId, SourceEpoch, AfterSourceSequence, and deadline
get_tm_modes.success: one sample with SourceSequence strictly greater than AfterSourceSequence in the same SourceEpoch
get_tm_modes.sequence_rule: never returns CURRENT as a substitute; unavailable retained history returns GAP with available bounds

generation_fencing: GetTM requires the exact active driver host and context-generation tuple.
NEXT revalidates the tuple after its wait and before returning a sample.
Context close, replacement, or host-generation change settles the query with STALE_GENERATION.
Observation queries do not reserve lifecycle capacity and cannot change context or attachment state.
durable_projection_rules: One backend collector performs CURRENT bootstrap and then NEXT reads; browsers never advance the driver source cursor.
Sample, current-item head, source cursor, gap fact, and observation outbox event commit atomically.
The current head advances only for the same source epoch and a greater source sequence.
Restart resumes from the committed source cursor; source-epoch change bootstraps CURRENT without comparing epochs.
A freshness transition is committed once when policy changes FRESH to STALE and returns to FRESH only on qualifying new evidence.
